svg.title: chapulin's speed beside OpenSSL over time on the AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor
svg.desc: Each panel is one row of docs/performance.md's table beside OpenSSL. A line is chapulin's speed in multiples of OpenSSL's at each recording. x86-64 gcc: runs on 16 days, from 2026-10-08 to 2026-11-17. x86-64 clang: runs on 16 days, from 2026-10-08 to 2026-11-17.
svg.text: chapulin's speed beside OpenSSL at each recording
AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor, from 2026-10-08 to 2026-11-17. A point above the dashed line at 1 is a run where chapulin was faster.
Each panel has its own scale. A line draws the last run of each day, and the number at its right is the last run's speed.
AES-128-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record sealed
AES-128-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record opened
AES-256-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record sealed
AES-256-GCM, the key set and one 16 KiB record opened
ChaCha20-Poly1305, 16 KiB encrypted and hashed, no tag
ChaCha20-Poly1305, 16 KiB hashed and decrypted, no tag
